Refactor GitHub authorization around resource scopes (#145)

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: fewensa-4
  description: |-
    Replace flattened repository-list GitHub grants with correlated tagged scopes and enforce account-route ceilings for every caller, including Owner and temporary approvals.
    
    - Role union and intersection keep account, resource, and access together as clauses.
    - An organization route contains that organization and its owned repositories; an exact repository contains only itself.
    - Owner bypasses ordinary role clauses but still needs a containing configured route whose max_access is sufficient.
    - Auto account selection uses configured routes, not public readability. Temporary approvals stay exact-repository grants and cannot exceed the route ceiling.
    - Tool lists remain compatibility-only; new exposure comes from access and the catalog.
    
    Validation: cargo test -p codeoff-runtime, cargo test -p codeoff-config, cargo test -p codeoff-mcp, cargo test -p codeoff-cli, cargo fmt --all -- --check, and targeted clippy with warnings denied.
